newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers down, bearish in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers down, bearish in thin trade.

text.p: Singapore bunkers were quoted down in quiet trading on Tuesday with many shipowners holding back their purchases following large overnight falls to crude prices which is expected to lead to lower cargo prices.
"Shipowners are holding back because of the big fall to crude prices and falling European prices," one trader said.
Traders said shipowners are taking reduced volumes preferring to take the full volume in the West.
Bunker 380-cst was quoted at $97-$99 per tonne and 180-cst at $104-$106. MDO and gas oil were quoted at $188-$192 and $200-205 respectively. --Singapore Newsroom (+65-870 3093)
